name: Outcome router
job: Central router for sale_outcome and appt_status force writes. Reads the opportunity, tags v2_outcome_*, and routes to the correct downstream workflow. Never stage-moves and never fires on MAR.

trigger.notes: Sole webhook-driven router. Payload includes contact_id, sale_outcome, sale_type, appt_status, ad_reason.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Inbound webhook GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL
named_steps.comment: Force writes enter here only. Must not accept payloads with sale_outcome=MAR (guarded below).

named_steps.name: WAIT: 60 seconds (opp settle)
named_steps.comment: Allows the upstream force-write to land on the opportunity before FIND-OPP.

named_steps.name: FIND-OPP: Latest open opp for contact
named_steps.comment: Native find opp. Must not create a new opp here. Must not read monetaryValue for logic.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Drop payload when sale_outcome=MAR
named_steps.comment: MAR never enters WF-05. Guard branch exits the workflow.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on sale_outcome (SOLD | AD | MUT)
named_steps.comment: Routes downstream. Must not write dollars. Must not move opp stages.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_outcome_sold (SOLD branch)
named_steps.comment: Tags outcome only. Must not stage-move.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: SOLD sub-branch on sale_type (new | renewal)
named_steps.comment: SOLD splits into onboarding vs renewal-nurture.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route SOLD new to WF-06 Onboarding
named_steps.comment: Onboarding owns membership_status writes; must not set it here.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route SOLD renewal to WF-09 Nurture
named_steps.comment: Renewal-nurture path. WF-09 owns renewal_date trigger.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route AD to WF-07 A&D
ADD-TO-WF: Route MUT to WF-11 Compliance
IF-ELSE: Branch on appt_status (no-show | cancel | reschedule)
named_steps.comment: appt_status routing. Reschedule must never be treated as no-show.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route no-show or cancel to WF-08
named_steps.comment: Only no-show and cancel enter WF-08; reschedule does not.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route reschedule to WF-03 Reminders
named_steps.comment: Reschedule re-enters reminders. Must not write appt_status=no-show.
